newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Fire hits Winbond's new wafer plant.
newsitem.headline: Fire hits Winbond's new wafer plant.

text.p: Fire swept through an unfinished wafer fabrication plant of Taiwan's semiconductor maker Winbond Electronics Corp on Monday, the firm said.
Winbond, Taiwan's third-biggest chipmaker, said the fire started in its new eight-inch wafer manufacturing plant at the northern Hsinchu Science Park in the afternoon and was under control.
"There were no casualties and financial losses have yet to be determined," Winbond said in a statement.
All equipment was fully insured, it said.
Plans to start production from the semiconductor plant in the first quarter of 1997 were unaffected, it said.
The cause of the fire was not immediately known.
